full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site055 and copy2site131 were inspected. Every body line, punctuation mark, math glyph, underline, note call and margin was compared. audit_131_details.jpg records the added looped letter and the copy2-only point before les équations. The separate margin slash and archive numbers were also inspected directly. Apart from the four recorded loci, the body readings agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Both original transcriptions were compared in full. The two copy2 manuscript additions and separate archive foliation were confirmed; the e reading retains its original doubt. The low point before les équations omitted from the supplied copy2 source has been restored with unresolved origin/status.

entries.decision: retain the added letter with its supplied e doubt
entries.reason: The narrow gray looped letter is present only in copy2 after dégagé. Its e reading remains uncertain; no lost or overwritten lower character is asserted.

entries.decision: retain the separate oblique margin stroke
entries.reason: A clear gray slash-shaped stroke stands in the left margin beside the dégagé line. It is absent from copy1.

entries.decision: retain the copy2-only doubtful low point
entries.reason: A distinct low point precedes les in copy2 and is absent in copy1. The category records the body-reading difference without deciding its origin or textual role.
The lower-left inscriptions read55 and131; no authorship attribution is made.

copy2_annotations.text_en: Copy 2 has “\unsure{.}les équations algébriques”: a small low point precedes “les”. Its origin and textual role remain unresolved.
